about_the_game:
Celebrate the Steam-wide Warhammer Skulls 2025 sale with the "Hues of Sanguine" Free DLC! Claim it until May 29 to grab an exclusive 2D style inspired by the grim dark universe of Warhammer 40,000 and some consumables!

The DLC contents:

  • ×1 "Hues of Sanguine" 2D style
  • ×3 Large Repair Kit
  • ×3 Large First Aid Kit
  • ×3 Automatic Fire Extinguisher
The "Hues of Sanguine" 2D style fits any U.S. vehicle. Adorn your favorite machine with it, for it is to bear forth the colors of the Blood Angels Chapter. The descendants of the valiant and puissant Primarch Sanguinius—the leader of one of the twenty First Founding Legions of the Space Marines—are renowned across the galaxy for their fierce nature in battle and endless devotion to the Emperor.
Demonstrate your battle prowess and make your favorite U.S. vehicle proudly wear the special Blood Angels’ hue of red and the glorious Aquila of the Imperium of Man!

You will not receive any items from the DLC if you have already claimed "Hues of Sanguine pack" in the in-game shop.
DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
Items will be credited to the first account you log in to the game with.
